title: Palace ‘seriously considering’ absolute pardon for Mary Jane Veloso — budget sponsor
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. is “seriously considering” granting absolute pardon to Mary Jane Veloso, the Office of the President’s budget sponsor at the House of Representatives said Wednesday.
